اغتصبنا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبْنَا (iḡtaṣabnā) /iɣ.ta.sˤab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبْنَا (uḡtuṣibnā) /uɣ.tu.sˤib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
